title: Master-data changes page v1
description: One page of `GET /api/v1/master-data/changes?since=N`: every master-data change after version N, in version order. A POS applies them in order, stores the last `version` it applied, and asks again with that as `since` while `hasMore` is true.

latestVersion.description: The company-wide master-data version when this page was read.

hasMore.description: More changes follow: ask again with `since` set to the last version on this page.

change.description: One master-data change. `data` is the whole record as it stood after the change, so a mirror simply overwrites. A POS skips an `entityType` it does not know, and ignores fields it does not know: contract 1.x only ever adds them.

version.description: The change's master-data version. Versions are handed out and committed in order, so a reader never sees N+1 before N.

entityType.description: `item` and `location` (branches) since contract 1.0; `menu_item`, `menu_price`, `modifier_group`, `menu_recipe` and `modifier_recipe` since 1.1 (ERP #16). Later minor versions may add more: a POS skips a kind it does not know.

item.description: An item the company stocks (ERP #5). A POS in connected mode mirrors it as an ingredient, matched by `itemCode`.

baseUnitCode.description: The unit every quantity of the item is in: `kg`, `piece`, `l`… Never changes.

variableWeight.description: Weighed, with a piece count alongside (whole birds): ADR-0005.

active.description: False once the item is no longer in use. Items are never deleted.

factor.description: How many base units one purchase unit holds, an exact decimal string.

location.description: A branch (ERP #6), matched on the POS by its ecosystem `locationCode`. Only branches appear: plants and warehouses are not a POS's business.

supersededBy.description: Set when a code already in use turned out wrong: the branch was replaced by the one named here, and this one deactivated. A POS moves the branch to the new code, keeping its sales history.

date.description: A business date, YYYY-MM-DD, in the chain's time zone (ERP ADR-0018).

money.description: Baht as the POS shows it, an exact decimal string with satang at most: "59", "59.5".

quantity.description: An exact decimal string in the item's base unit, never a JSON number (ERP ADR-0019).

menuItem.description: Since 1.1. Something a branch sells (ERP #16). Its code is the `menuItemCode` a sales event carries.

categoryTh.description: The heading the POS lists it under, in Thai. A label, not a code: items with the same label share a heading, and a renamed category arrives as a changed label on each item.

soldBy.description: `portion`: a sale line carries `quantity`. `weight`: a sale line carries `weightKg`, and the price is per kilogram. Never changes.

active.description: False once it is no longer sold. Menu items are never deleted.

modifierGroupCodes.description: The modifier groups it offers, in the order the POS shows them.

menuPrice.description: Since 1.1. A selling price from a business date, chain-wide (`locationCode` null) or for one branch. Tax is the POS's business: this is the price as the POS shows it. A branch row with `price` null ends that branch's own price: from `effectiveFrom` the branch charges the chain-wide price in force again. A chain-wide row always has a price.

locationCode.description: The branch whose price this is, or null for every branch without a price of its own.

price.description: Per portion, or per kilogram for a menu item sold by weight. Never negative. Null only on a branch row: from `effectiveFrom` that branch charges the chain-wide price in force again, including chain-wide prices that start later, until it gets a price of its own again.

modifierGroup.description: Since 1.1. A set of options a menu item offers, with all its options in order. Each option's code is the `modifiers[].code` a sales event carries, unique across groups.

minSelections.description: The fewest options a customer must choose (0: optional).

maxSelections.description: The most options a customer may choose.

priceChange.description: Added to the line's price per unit sold (per portion, or per kilogram); may be zero or negative.

active.description: False once it is no longer offered. Options are never removed from the list.

unitCode.description: The item's base unit, which `quantity` is in.

menuRecipe.description: Since 1.1. One version of a menu item's recipe, in force from `effectiveFrom` until the next version starts. The ERP explodes sales into usage with it; a POS needs it only to show it.

per.description: What the quantities are for: one portion, or one kilogram sold of a menu item sold by weight.

modifierRecipe.description: Since 1.1. One version of a modifier option's recipe: what the option adds (above zero) or removes (below zero) per one unit sold of the line it is on. Usage = option recipe × modifier quantity × line quantity (or `weightKg`).
